titulo: Why can't you divide by zero? 🤔
descripcion: Division is multiplication backwards. Once you see it that way, dividing by zero breaks instantly.

escenas.texto: Type six divided by zero into any calculator, and it just gives up. Error. But why?
Division is just multiplication backwards. Six divided by two is three, because three times two is six.
So six divided by zero asks: what number, times zero, gives six?
There isn't one. Anything times zero is zero. So there's no answer at all.
And zero divided by zero is even worse: every number works, so there's no single answer either.
That's why math calls it undefined. Not infinity, just a question with no answer. Follow for more math that makes sense.
